servinfo.title: How to Read System Circuit Diagram
servinfo.ptxt: The circuit diagram is designed so the current flows from the top of the diagram (power source) to the bottom of the diagram (ground) as if giving an image of water flow.

attention3.ptxt: This means “Jump to the page directed with the arrow(s) by their number”.
(For example: “Two arrows directing left” means “Jump to two pages before”.)
You will find the same symbol with the arrows directing opposite in the referenced page. The circuit continues between the symbols.
The circuit continues to the same symbol with opposite direction within the page.
You will find the other symbol in arrow direction.

servinfo.ptxt: The white arrow between A and B means “or”.

ptxt.emph: [K]: Twisted wires (Both CAN lines and non-CAN lines)
[Q]: Base color “LVN” (Lavender) represents aluminum electric wire
